name: Gelves (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gelves (a cypress and an anchor on yellow above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Gelves; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
